items.name: Abacus
items.effect: Boon on INT rolls for solving mathematical problems.
items.description: A counting frame with beads that can be moved along rods. It is used for performing arithmetic calculations.

items.name: Blanket
items.effect: Required to avoid a bane on rolls to avoid the effects of cold (page 54).
items.description: A large piece of woolen cloth used for warmth.

items.name: Chess Set
items.effect: Opposed roll for INT determines who wins.
items.description: A game played on a checkered board with pieces that move in different ways. It is used for strategic thinking and planning.

items.name: Dice
items.effect: Chance determines who wins.
items.description: A small cube with numbers on each side. It is used for games of chance.

items.name: Field Kitchen
items.effect: Boon on BUSHCRAFT rolls for cooking (page 103).
items.description: A portable kitchen used for cooking food in the field.

items.name: Field Ration
items.effect: Eat one per day, otherwise you become hungry (page 54).
items.description: A pre-packaged meal that can be eaten in the field.

items.name: Grappling Hook
items.effect: Can be used to secure a rope. Can be thrown and secured with an ACROBATICS roll up to STR meters (STRx2 with a bane).
items.description: A hook with a rope attached to it. It is used for climbing and securing objects.

items.name: Advanced Lockpicks
items.effect: Boon on SLEIGHT OF HAND rolls for picking locks.
items.description: A set of advanced tools used for picking locks. It is used for breaking and entering.

items.name: Simple Lockpicks
items.effect: Required to avoid a bane on SLEIGHT OF HAND rolls for picking locks.
items.description: A set of tools used for picking locks. It is used for breaking and entering.

items.name: Magnifying Glass
items.effect: Boon on SPOT HIDDEN.
items.description: A glass lens used for magnifying small objects. It is used for examining details.

items.name: Map
items.effect: Required to avoid a bane on BUSHCRAFT rolls for leading the way.
items.description: A representation of an area of land. It is used for navigation.

items.name: Marbles
items.effect: Can be thrown at a humanoid enemy within 10 meters, as an action. Next turn the enemy must make an EVADE roll (not an action) in order to move.
items.description: A small glass ball used for playing games. It is used for entertainment.

items.name: Padlock
items.effect: Locks a door or chest. Can take 20 points of damage, armor rating 5.
items.description: A lock that can be used to secure a door or chest. It is used for security.

items.name: Perfume (10 doses)
items.effect: Boon on CHA-based skill rolls when the GM finds it reasonable.
items.description: A fragrant liquid used for scent. It is used for personal hygiene and attraction.

items.name: Playing Cards
items.effect: Opposed roll for BLUFFING determines who wins.
items.description: A set of cards used for playing games. It is used for entertainment.

items.name: Quiver of Iron Head Arrows
items.effect: Required to fire bows or crossbows.
items.description: A container with iron head arrows. It is used for archery.

items.name: Quiver of Wooden Head Arrows
items.effect: Required to fire bows or crossbows. The effectiveness of armor is doubled.
items.description: A container with wooden head arrows. It is used for archery.

items.name: Hemp Rope (10 meters)
items.effect: Boon on ACROBATICS rolls for climbing, but the rope must be secured.
items.description: A strong rope made of hemp. It is used for climbing and securing objects.

items.name: Silk Rope (10 meters)
items.effect: Boon on ACROBATICS rolls for climbing, but the rope must be secured.
items.description: A strong rope made of silk. It is used for climbing and securing objects.

items.name: Saddle
items.effect: Required to avoid a bane when fighting from horseback.
items.description: A seat for a rider on a horse or other animal. It is used for riding.

items.name: Sleeping Fur
items.effect: Required to avoid a bane on BUSHCRAFT rolls for making camp.
items.description: A fur-lined bag used for sleeping. It is used for warmth and comfort.

items.name: Spyglass
items.effect: Boon on BUSHCRAFT rolls for leading the way during journeys.
items.description: A telescope used for viewing distant objects. It is used for navigation and observation.

items.name: Small Tent
items.effect: Can accommodate up to two people. Grants a boon on BUSHCRAFT rolls for making camp. Only one person rolls, but others can help.
items.description: A portable shelter made of cloth or other material. It is used for camping.

items.name: Large Tent
items.effect: Can accommodate up to six people. Grants a boon on BUSHCRAFT rolls for making camp. Only one person rolls, but others can help.
items.description: A larger portable shelter made of cloth or other material. It is used for camping.

items.name: Whistle
items.effect: Can be heard from up to 100 meters away.
items.description: A small instrument that produces a high-pitched sound. It is used for signaling.
